title: Cyrus and the Wolf
author: Mirabel Voss
blurb: Oscar Joubert, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
